title: Backend Developer
profile: Backend engineer with production experience across Java/Spring Boot and Node.js/NestJS, PostgreSQL, and REST API design. I own systems end to end: a financial computation engine, a JWT/RBAC authentication architecture, a Kafka event-driven integration, and a from-scratch platform migration, with a consistent focus on data integrity and security. Comfortable picking up new stacks fast, recent work spans Kotlin, TypeScript, Rust, and Dart.

education.institution: Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology
education.degree: BSc Computer Science with MTN Bright Scholarship Reloaded. First Class Honours

bullets: Architected a JWT RSA-based authentication and authorization system with SSO integration, custom @Authorization annotations, and role-based access control across six user roles.

Owned an automated financial computation engine end to end (data model, API, and a Kafka integration publishing finalized data to the payroll system), with versioned configs and cascade-safe deletion to protect referential integrity.
Enforced data-integrity constraints via PostgreSQL triggers and resolved N+1 query performance issues in a GraphQL integration through batch fetching.
Built rate limiting (100 req/min/user) and maintained 70%+ test coverage (JaCoCo, Hurl E2E) as part of a production-grade engineering standard.
Led a from-scratch EMR migration from TSOA to NestJS/Prisma with zero data loss, restructuring serialized JSON columns while keeping the API surface backward compatible for existing clients.

2.5+ years progressively owning backend systems for a health-tech platform, from intern to freelance engineer: cloud file storage, verification flows, PDF generation, and real-time notifications (SSE, WebSocket/Socket.io).

Built and run Orbit, an internal project tracker in real daily use by a small dev group: Nuxt 4, Nitro API on Vercel serverless functions, Postgres/Drizzle, with encrypted secrets (AES-256-GCM), audit logging, and TOTP MFA.
Built Orbit's MCP server exposing projects, issues, sprints, and secrets as tools, plus a published GitHub Action that pulls a project's secrets from Orbit straight into CI, log-masked.

projects.name: Adzesua: Multi-Tenant School Management Platform
bullets: Building a multi-tenant Spring Boot/Kotlin backend (tenant onboarding, fee structures, installment billing, Paystack payments) with Google OAuth2 and structured request-lifecycle logging.
Designed and delivered a full-stack website end to end, live in production: Prisma ORM and PostgreSQL backend, deployed on Vercel with image CDN optimization for fast, responsive delivery.
